'''Talus''' was a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as one of the "twin rulers" of [[Typha-Dor]], alongside [[Binalu]], in the years leading up to the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
In [[25 BBY/Legends|25 BBY]], during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], Talus supported the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] and fought against an imminent invasion of his world by the fleet of [[Vanqor/Legends|Vanqor]], a neighboring [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Uziel system]].

As leader of the [[Typha-Dor High Council]], Talus petitioned the Senate that it rush Jedi diplomats to his planet's aid and was intimately involved in the high-security and strategic planning meetings preparatory to Vanqor's imminent attempt to invade. He approved a preemptive countermeasure, based on [[Mission to Typha-Dor|secret intelligence]], to trap the Vanqor fleet in a [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] corridor through which the enemy made its approach.

Talus worked not only with [[High General]] [[Bycha]] and his lesser [[General/Legends|generals]], but also with [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], [[Clee Rhara]], [[Siri Tachi/Legends|Siri Tachi]], and the other [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] envoys sent at the behest of the Senate, to negotiate a ceasefire and an enduring peace between Typha-Dor and Vanqor's ruler, [[Van-Ith]].
